run_order: per image, even repeat: L2 then L3
per image, odd repeat: L3 then L2
method: Same process, interleaved per image and repetition: even repeat L2 then L3; odd repeat L3 then L2. One excluded warmup per image/configuration, then ten measurements. Median of ten raw times per image/configuration, followed by mean of eight image medians.

paired.order: Even repeats L2,L3; odd repeats L3,L2 in the same process
Even repeats L2,L3; odd repeats L3,L2 in the same process

limitations: 1.bmp is the template source; only seven other positive images are independent of it.
No negative dataset or labeled accuracy evaluation; false-positive rates cannot be estimated.
Scores are similarities, not probabilities; differing pyramid settings can change scores.
Contour symmetry and unsigned gradients can produce approximately 180-degree angle ambiguity.
The reported FPS is 1000 / mean match time, not end-to-end throughput.
ABBA reduces order drift but is a single round and supplies no confidence interval.
The original ABBA runs show timing drift; their approximately 1.55 ratio is retained only as a diagnostic. Interleaved results are primary when available.

abba_diagnostic.warning: Pronounced late-run timing drift was observed, especially in L2_B images 6..8 and L3_B image 8. The ABBA ratio (approximately 1.55 in this round) is diagnostic, not a precise speedup estimate.
abba_diagnostic.method: ABBA: L2_A, L3_A, L3_B, L2_B; each run has one excluded warmup and seven measured calls per image. Pool the two runs of each configuration per image, take the median of 14 raw times, then average the eight image medians.

config.order: Even repeats L2,L3; odd repeats L3,L2 in the same process
